sentences.en: The roads diverge up ahead; take the left one.
sentences.zh: 前面的路分开了，走左边那条。

sentences.en: Berber and Semitic languages diverged from each other several thousands of years ago.
sentences.zh: 柏柏语和闪语在几千年以前就开始分化了。
放学后，他们的生活就分道扬镳了。

senses.zh: 改变方向：change；（使）分叉，散开：different directions central；分歧：different, differ；离题：depart from

mnemonic: 词根记忆：di（分开）+verg（转）+e→转开→分开
